title: Mentor capacity for two six-week ramps
method: Synthetic staffing exercise: two learners ×three hours weekly ×six weeks =36 hours. Budgeting one hour each instead gives 12 hours, leaving 24 hours unallocated. It does not predict ramp duration or hiring quality.
alt: Bars show 36 hours of planned support versus 12 hours in an underbudgeted plan.
